changes: Made Music downloads resume partial files after connection resets and changed playlist downloading to 25 slots with 3 attempts.

Reviewed and tightened Music playlist downloading so failed songs do not appear as downloaded, missing local files are detected, index renumbering reuses existing files, and retry/parallel download behavior is calmer.
Added a default-on background music setting that keeps playback in a foreground service with a persistent notification.
Compacted Music playlist numbering after removals so downloaded songs keep a continuous index.
Fixed Music playlist updates so removed YouTube songs are deleted locally and additions/removals both refresh correctly.
Auto-scrolled column charts to the latest values after saving a new tracker entry.
Changed column chart swiping to use evenly spaced exercise-day slots so labels move smoothly with the bars.
Added a swipeable 3-day time window for column charts.
Changed changelog badges to derive Release and Beta from the current highest Release version instead of storing a tag on every entry.
Added APK update download size and progress feedback on the Info page.
Bumped the app version so clients refresh the expanded online changelog.
Moved the changelog online to the beta APK branch.
Added beta and release color coding to changelog entries.
Cached the online changelog locally until the highest known version changes.
Renamed tracker description mode from Value to Values.
Added a Settings value selector for choosing which tracker values appear in tracker descriptions.
Fixed unilateral column chart groups so bars and side labels do not overlap between dates.
Cleared Music search after selecting a song.
Improved unilateral column value labels when charts are crowded.
Kept Weight values readable with up to two decimal places.
Changed all column chart scales to use the same doubled-and-rounded max rule that Reps uses.
Changed top set selection to use the other tracked values as tie-breakers when Weight is the same.
Changed displayed tracker stats so every value comes from the same top set, with Weight deciding the top set when available.
Changed Reps column chart scaling to use integer ticks from 0 to double the highest reps rounded up to the next 10.
Changed column charts so Reps scales always start at 0.
Highlighted the latest known Info version numbers in green across Local, Release, and Beta.
Changed Info version display to show Local, Release, and Beta versions separately.
Added automatic playlist change checks when opening Music.
Added a confirmation popup before downloading playlist changes.
Changed the Release update channel to use the main APK branch.
Removed the separate release branch from the update setup.
Added selectable Release and Beta update channels on the Info page.
Changed update checks to use the selected APK branch.
Changed unilateral column bar colors to match the selected metric legend colors.
Grouped unilateral column bars by side so selected values sit next to each other.
Added spacing between left and right column groups.
Made unilateral chart series colors distinct and cleaned up column labels.
Limited chart metric selection to two values at once.
Added a right-side scale for the second graphed value.
Changed multi-graph labels to show only their own metric value.
Removed progress text from chart metric buttons.
Changed the changelog popup to use a single Close button.
Changed chart metric buttons from single-select to multi-select.
Allowed multiple selected metrics to draw together on the chart.
Turned the chart legend into metric selector buttons.
Added filled and outlined dots to show the selected graph metric.
Fixed tracker value descriptions showing with awkward empty space above the value.
Added a Settings dropdown for tracker descriptions.
Added per-tracker Highest or Lowest value display when tracker descriptions are set to Value.
Fixed the Settings checkbox focus outline so it stays within the toggle bounds.
Hid the graph mode selector completely when time trackers are forced to Column view.
Added the Settings page.
Added a toggle to hide the Line chart option for trackers that include Time.
Time-based trackers use Column view while that setting is enabled.
Changed time tracking from raw seconds to hours, minutes, and seconds inputs.
Changed time values to display in readable time format.
Added the Changelog button and newest-first update popup.
Fixed column chart bars starting below the visible graph area.
Added editing for existing history entries.
Added a date/time picker for edited entries.
Added entry edit support for adding and removing sets.
Added per-tracker graph mode selection between line and column charts.
Kept set-card header height stable when remove buttons appear.
Preserved typed entry values when adding or removing sets before saving.
Paused music when Android reports headphones or Bluetooth audio disconnected.
Saved and restored the current music track, playback position, and repeat mode.
Published a test update version for validating the startup update popup.
Made music download cancellation actually stop native downloads.
Removed completed songs from the download progress popup.
Hid the music download progress bar while idle.
Added startup update checking with Download and Later choices.
Added the Music section.
Integrated native YouTube playlist downloading and playback.
Added native update metadata support for the APK-only GitHub repository.
Renamed exercise wording to tracker wording.
Changed history label Best to Highest.
Improved Android back button handling and exit confirmation.
Added the top-level menu with Trackers, Timer, Info, and Music.
Added custom delete confirmation popups.
Changed new entries to start with one set.
Fixed cramped close buttons in tracker popups.
Added multi-set entries.
Added bilateral and unilateral tracker modes.
Added selectable tracked metrics for weight, reps, time, and number.
Added separate left and right graph series for unilateral trackers.
Centered custom input popups.
Cleaned up history cards.
Removed set prefixes from graph labels.
Kept secondary metrics in labels while graphing the primary metric.
Created the GymApp mobile tracker UI.
Added user-managed categories and trackers.
Added add, rename, and delete flows.
Added kg weight labels and removed sample default data.
Added category and grid-based tracker selection.
Fixed mobile scrolling and chart sizing issues.
Added readable history and chart axes.
Added Music, app update checks, playlist downloading, settings, and the changelog popup.
